body:
Follow-up of #9496. When compiling the `cupy.cuda.{thrust, cub}` modules, a few deprecation warnings are raised. We should try to migrate the code to newer constructs in CCCL v3.x so as to eliminate the warnings.

**UPDATE**: as of April 17, 2026 I see this:
```
cupy/cuda/cupy_cub.cu: In instantiation of 'void _cub_reduce_argmin::operator()(void*, size_t&, void*, void*, int, cudaStream_t) [with T = signed char; size_t = long unsigned int; cudaStream_t = CUstream_st*]':
/local/home/leof/dev/cupy_cuda131_relaxed/cupy/_core/include/cupy/type_dispatcher.cuh:41:48:   required from 'void dtype_dispatcher(int, functor_t, Ts&& ...) [with functor_t = _cub_reduce_argmin; Ts = {void*&, long unsigned int&, void*&, void*&, int&, CUstream_st*&}]'
   41 |     case CUPY_TYPE_INT8:       return f.template operator()<int8_t>(std::forward<Ts>(args)...);
      |                 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
cupy/cuda/cupy_cub.cu:1044:33:   required from here
 1044 |     case CUPY_CUB_ARGMIN:   return dtype_dispatcher(dtype_id, _cub_reduce_argmin(),
      |                 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~                                 
cupy/cuda/cupy_cub.cu:917:49: warning: 'static cudaError_t cub::CUB_300102_SM_860_890::DeviceReduce::ArgMin(void*, size_t&, InputIteratorT, OutputIteratorT, int, cudaStream_t) [with InputIteratorT = signed char*; OutputIteratorT = cub::CUB_300102_SM_860_890::KeyValuePair<int, signed char>*; cudaError_t = cudaError; size_t = long unsigned int; cudaStream_t = CUstream_st*]' is deprecated: CUB has superseded this interface in favor of the ArgMin interface that takes two separate iterators: one iterator to which the extremum is written and another iterator to which the index of the found extremum is written.  [-Wdeprecated-declarations]
  917 |         DeviceReduce::ArgMin(workspace, workspace_size, static_cast<T*>(x),
      |         ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~                                                                                                           
/local/home/leof/dev/cupy_cuda131_relaxed/cupy/_core/include/cupy/_cccl/cub/cub/device/device_reduce.cuh:1091:1: note: declared here
 1091 |     ArgMin(void* d_temp_storage,
      | ^   ~~
cupy/cuda/cupy_cub.cu: In instantiation of 'void _cub_reduce_argmax::operator()(void*, size_t&, void*, void*, int, cudaStream_t) [with T = signed char; size_t = long unsigned int; cudaStream_t = CUstream_st*]':
/local/home/leof/dev/cupy_cuda131_relaxed/cupy/_core/include/cupy/type_dispatcher.cuh:41:48:   required from 'void dtype_dispatcher(int, functor_t, Ts&& ...) [with functor_t = _cub_reduce_argmax; Ts = {void*&, long unsigned int&, void*&, void*&, int&, CUstream_st*&}]'
   41 |     case CUPY_TYPE_INT8:       return f.template operator()<int8_t>(std::forward<Ts>(args)...);
      |                 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
cupy/cuda/cupy_cub.cu:1046:33:   required from here
 1046 |     case CUPY_CUB_ARGMAX:   return dtype_dispatcher(dtype_id, _cub_reduce_argmax(),
      |                 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~                                 
cupy/cuda/cupy_cub.cu:932:49: warning: 'static cudaError_t cub::CUB_300102_SM_860_890::DeviceReduce::ArgMax(void*, size_t&, InputIteratorT, OutputIteratorT, int, cudaStream_t) [with InputIteratorT = signed char*; OutputIteratorT = cub::CUB_300102_SM_860_890::KeyValuePair<int, signed char>*; cudaError_t = cudaError; size_t = long unsigned int; cudaStream_t = CUstream_st*]' is deprecated: CUB has superseded this interface in favor of the ArgMax interface that takes two separate iterators: one iterator to which the extremum is written and another iterator to which the index of the found extremum is written.  [-Wdeprecated-declarations]
  932 |         DeviceReduce::ArgMax(workspace, workspace_size, static_cast<T*>(x),
      |         ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~                                                                                                           
/local/home/leof/dev/cupy_cuda131_relaxed/cupy/_core/include/cupy/_cccl/cub/cub/device/device_reduce.cuh:1461:1: note: declared here
 1461 |     ArgMax(void* d_temp_storage,
      | ^   ~~
```
title: Make CCCL compilation warning-free
